sourceText: Follow-up to B-8128: build the three deferred capability-release lifecycle pieces — the live capability_release_backfill command (run on real B-785e/PBP-882), M6 candidate exposure records, M7 structured-outcome + promotion recommendation wiring — on top of B-8128 foundation and already-enforced safety invariants.
normalizedOutcome: The live PBP-882 becomes bound to its capability release; capability candidates are exposable as pending learning with exposure records and promotable only on concrete exposure + structured verdict.
acceptanceClaim: capability_release_backfill binds the live PBP-882 idempotently; the bound candidate surfaces in promotion_status with an exposure record; a structured outcome + promotion sweep works for capability candidates while DONE-success never counts as helped and candidates never auto-activate.
